query:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (m.user_id)
            m.user_id,
            u.email,
            m.days_without_data,
            m.last_data_timestamp,
            m.data_sources
        FROM data_quality_metrics m
        JOIN users u ON m.user_id = u.id
        WHERE m.days_without_data >= $1
        ORDER BY m.user_id, m.metric_date DESC, m.days_without_data DESC
        LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3
